title: Concept: Shared static SimpleDateFormat (java)
description: A shared SimpleDateFormat mutates internal state during formatting and parsing. Concurrent use yields wrong dates or exceptions. The remedy is DateTimeFormatter or a per-call formatter.
applicability: Java servlets, services, and components holding formatter fields; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Corrupted timestamps and cross-request data mix-ups under concurrency; LOW severity.
